# Membrane IVF Plugin v0.9.2 - Table of Contents

> Membrane plugin for IVF container

## Pages

- [Membrane IVF Plugin](https://membrane-ivf-plugin.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [LICENSE](https://membrane-ivf-plugin.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [Membrane.IVF.Deserializer](https://membrane-ivf-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.IVF.Deserializer.md): Deserializer is capable of converting stream representing video in IVF format
into stream of Membrane.Buffer's with video frames with correct timestamps in
Membrane timebase (it is 1 nanosecond = 1/(10^9)[s])
- [Membrane.IVF.Headers.FileHeader](https://membrane-ivf-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.IVF.Headers.FileHeader.md): A struct representing IVF file header

- [Membrane.IVF.Headers.FrameHeader](https://membrane-ivf-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.IVF.Headers.FrameHeader.md): A struct representing IVF frame header

- [Membrane.IVF.Serializer](https://membrane-ivf-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.IVF.Serializer.md): Serializes video stream into IVF format.
